Purpose: High-level visualization intent for deterministic recipe adaptation. Keep hints sparse and non-conflicting.

Visual Mood.Guidance: Choose one. Describes emotional posture, not specific effects.

Visual Motion.Guidance: Choose one. Controls apparent motion intensity.

Visual Lyric Presence.Guidance: Use off for instrumental or text-minimal intent; auto when uncertain.

WhenToWrite: Write hints when song concept clearly implies visual direction.
Write no more than 3-5 hint lines to avoid over-constraining.
If uncertain, prefer omitting optional fields.
ConflictAvoidance: Do not emit contradictory pairs (e.g., Visual Motion high + Visual Density sparse unless intentional).
Avoid overusing Visual NoGo; reserve for explicit exclusions.
